motivation: AAI-02B invalid shuffled-label control, AAI-03A and AAI-04R1 negative headroom. AAI-05 tests actual per-world rule learning rather than repeated benchmark-headroom admission.
hypothesis: Direct nongradient online causal motif editing yields improved novel-world action reward over fully trained logistic and decision-tree controls, with exact cold retention, and approaches a catalog-aware exact Bayesian mixture.

environment.input: Six binary bits: four-bit state 0..15 and two-bit action 0..3
environment.output: Two causal consequence bits, each generated by one of 60 rules (15 distinct input pairs x four operators XOR,AND,OR,XNOR)
environment.law: World rule pair sampled independently from SHA256(seed,bit). DEV operator choices XOR/AND; TRANSFER operator choices OR/XNOR. Learners receive no hidden law or operation label.
environment.observations: Exactly 16 unique do(state,action) probes from 64 possibilities, same per-world input and noisy consequence for every learner; independent output bit flips at P=.08, SHA256 keyed
environment.terminal: 12 unseen state-target pairs/world, target independent of law. Choose action of four; evaluate noiseless consequence with reward = 1 - Hamming(actual,target)/2
environment.persistence: JSON serialize learned state, train twice on independent other worlds, reload original, require identical predictions. No original-world retraining.
environment.negative: Shuffled intervention response training (frozen deterministic permutation), and no use of passive records as interventions.

splits.mechanical_only: 900000..900031; may validate invariants but not inspect scientific cohort results before first use

arms.direct: For each of two bits, score all 60 causal programs by streaming log-likelihood on 16 do records; store the maximum-score program id only. Direct weight/candidate editing, no gradients.
arms.bayes: Full per-bit likelihood-weighted mixture over all 60 programs, same examples, known catalog and noise; strong structured control, not oracle of the true world law.
arms.logistic: Fully trained per-world logistic with intercept + 6 single bits + 15 pairwise bit interactions, 300 full-batch epochs, learning rate 0.15, zero init; same examples.
arms.cart: Fully trained deterministic depth-3 CART Gini tree on six inputs, no hidden labels and same examples.
arms.lookup: Memorize observed input/output pairs, otherwise use learned marginal majority per bit.
arms.shuffled: Train direct candidate scores on deterministic within-world shuffled consequence labels, only in negative cohort.

measured: Per-world paired differences vs strongest trained baseline and Bayesian mixture
JSON cold-restore equality after two unrelated worlds
Per-method total fit+inference elapsed time and serialized model bytes
scientific_candidate: On transfer, direct - max(CART, logistic) >= +0.03; paired 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0; direct - Bayes >= -0.025; DEV direct - strongest conventional >= -0.02; negative direct - shuffled >= +0.10; every cold/interference output identical; no evaluator leakage or budget mismatches. Candidate only, independent qualification required before any integration.
negative: Any required threshold failed; report valid negative/mixed without post-result adjustment.
invalid: Leaks, source drift, disjointness failure, unbounded resources, invalid predictor, or nondeterminism. Separate from scientific negative.
isolation: Independent external Yggdrasil contributor research only; no native model/weights/owner controller/runner/queue/schedule/accepted-ref modification, merge or deployment.
